subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 8th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 8th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is three days away from the group's current location.
source_quote: Three days.

subject: Darklake description
fact: The Darklake is a large body of water in the Underdark, described as a large water balloon where intersecting caverns, caves, and tunnels allow navigation.
source_quote: The Darklake is a large body of water. Unlike the overbrite, it doesn’t have a surface in the conventional sense. It’s a large water balloon in the Underdark, where intersecting caverns, caves, and tunnels allow navigation.

subject: Spectator count
fact: One Spectator, a kind of Beholder, attacks the group.
source_quote: a floating sphere with a gaping maw and a single great eye, set within four eyestalks

subject: Velkynvelve to Sloobludop route
fact: The group started in Velkynvelve and has been heading towards Sloobludop.
source_quote: We started in Velkynvelve. We have been heading towards Sloobludop.

subject: Gracklstugh location
fact: Gracklstugh is a large Derro city located after Sloobludop.
source_quote: After we get to Sloobludop, Buppido says we should go to Gracklstugh. Gracklstugh is a large Derro city.

subject: tomb location
fact: The floating tomb of Brysis of Khaem is on the eastern edge of the Darklake.
source_quote: It’s on the eastern edge of the Darklake.

subject: mimic detection
fact: The group encounters a large chest that is identified as a mimic.
source_quote: they see a large chest. There is a momentary desire to see if it’s a treasure chest, but all agree it’s a mimic.

subject: Spectator attack sequence
fact: The Spectator uses a confusion ray on Thorin, a paralysis ray on Zalthir, and a blue ray that fails to affect Thorin.
source_quote: It uses a confusion ray on Thorin. ... One of the eyestalks, meanwhile, emits an eerie green ray, and Zalthir is now paralyzed. A blue ray from another eyestalk strikes Thorin, but Thorin is unaffected.

subject: goblin guide count
fact: Two goblin guides, Yukyuk and Spiderbait, accompany the group.
source_quote: Yukyuk and Spiderbait

subject: giant spider count
fact: The group is pursued by Giant Spiders, which are multiple in number.
source_quote: the Giant Spiders

subject: Sethir's map explanation
fact: Sethir uses a scrap of Ormu to draw a map showing the group's route from Velkynvelve to Sloobludop.
source_quote: He uses the Ormu that Zalthir had collected from the narrow tunnel they had squeezed through. "Now, this isn’t a map of the tunnels, but it will give you an idea of where we are and where we are going."

subject: Zalthir's myconid mind network
fact: Zalthir reaches out through the mind network of the myconid to communicate with the Spectator.
source_quote: Zalthir reaches out through the mind network of the myconid

subject: Jimjar's bet failure
fact: Jimjar takes a bet that he can convince the Spectator they are not demons and fails.
source_quote: Jimjar, I’ll make a bet you can’t convince him that we are not demons and not enemies.” Jimjar takes the bet and fails.

subject: Zalthir's spiderweb maneuver
fact: Zalthir hangs from a spiderweb to attack the Spectator but misses due to the difficulty of the maneuver.
source_quote: While hanging on the spiderweb, he attempts to strike the creature. Unfortunately, the effort to hold on and attack is too much, and he misses.

subject: Thorin's hill strike
fact: Thorin uses a hill strike battle technique learned from a hill giant battle master against the Spectator.
source_quote: Thorin swings his sword, leveraging an old battle technique called a hill strike, which he learned from a hill giant battle master.

subject: Daz's magic missiles
fact: Daz unleashes swift darts of pure magic, described as glowing teardrops of blue-white force.
source_quote: Glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight.

subject: Zalthir's belly touch
fact: Zalthir touches Fargas’s belly to check for gnoll spawn.
source_quote: Zalthir then walks up to Fargas and touches his belly.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot status
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is a halfling adventurer who claims knowledge of a hidden tomb.
source_quote: Fargas Rumblefoot

subject: Grygum's note-taking
fact: Grygum took notes while Fargas was speaking and later repeated his claims.
source_quote: I took notes while you were talking,

subject: Brysis's tomb
fact: The half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb that fell into the Underdark after the fall of Netheril.
source_quote: the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb. After the fall of the empire of Netheril and its flying cities, Brysis’s tomb plummeted into a crevasse and wound up in the Underdark

subject: Silken Paths location
fact: The group is traveling through the Silken Paths, a network of spiderwebs in the Underdark.
source_quote: We are at the Silken Paths.

subject: Spectator type
fact: The creature is a Spectator, a kind of Beholder.
source_quote: a Spectator, a kind of Beholder

subject: escapees' decision to continue
fact: The escapees decide to continue their journey through the Underdark after defeating the Spectator.
source_quote: With the danger gone, ... the escapees move forward.

subject: goblin guides' loyalty shift
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait decide to stay with the escapees after witnessing Zalthir’s spiderweb maneuver.
source_quote: Yukyuk is very impressed with Zalthir, “That was some next-level spider walking. Like going underneath the spider web and attacking the creature.” ... And so they decide to stay with the escapees.

subject: Ormu material
fact: Sethir uses Ormu collected from a narrow tunnel to draw a map.
source_quote: He uses the Ormu that Zalthir had collected from the narrow tunnel they had squeezed through.
